summary: Sify Technologies Limited filed a Form 6-K on July 16, 2026, reporting its consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, under IFRS. The announcement is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. It includes revenue of INR 12,352 million, adjusted EBITDA of INR 3,005 million, and net profit of INR 65 million, with management commentary on digital transformation trends. No deal terms, M&A activity, or strategic events are present. The filing is a standard periodic report for a foreign private issuer.
